setup_graph_parallel_groups: setup graph parallel and data parallel process groups for distributed training with a given group size and backend
setup_gp: setup graph parallel groups from a config dictionary specifying gp_gpus and distributed_backend for distributed training
reduce_from_model_parallel_region: reduce a tensor across the graph parallel region using all_reduce for model parallel training
scatter_to_model_parallel_region: scatter a tensor across the graph parallel region by splitting along the first dimension for model parallel training
scale_backward_grad: scale backward gradients by the graph parallel world size to correct gradient values during distributed training
